stories.title: EN DIRECT - Primaire à gauche : «Il faut une gauche démocratique dans notre pays», affirme Raphaël Glucksmann au journal télévisé après sa victoire

en.title: LIVE - Left primary: "We need a democratic left in our country," says Raphaël Glucksmann on television after his victory
en.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann won the left primary election with 66.17% of votes in the first round, securing the social-democratic left's candidacy for the presidential election.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : "Je dis à François Hollande qu'il est le bienvenu dans cette dynamique", lance Raphaël Glucksmann qui souhaite un rassemblement plus large que la primaire

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: "I tell François Hollande he is welcome in this movement," says Raphaël Glucksmann who wants broader unity than the primary
en.summary: Glucksmann, who defeated his rivals including Socialist Party leader Olivier Faure, will be the candidate of both parties for the presidency and is seeking to expand support beyond the primary.

stories.title: Raphaël Glucksmann largement élu candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate pour la présidentielle

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann overwhelmingly elected candidate of the social-democratic left for the presidential election
en.summary: The 46-year-old MEP Glucksmann won the social-democratic left primary in the first round, pledging to unite the democratic left and defeat the far-right despite divisions over alliances with France Unbowed.

stories.title: Primaire à gauche : après sa victoire, Hollande félicite Glucksmann, qui lui tend la main en vue de la présidentielle

en.title: Left primary: after his victory, Hollande congratulates Glucksmann, who reaches out to him ahead of the presidential election
en.summary: Glucksmann, the winner of the left primary, expressed openness to welcoming Hollande into his campaign movement for the upcoming presidential race.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, primaire à gauche : Raphaël Glucksmann, élu dès le premier tour, promet de « rassembler » la gauche pour « battre l’extrême droite », et réaffirme son refus de s’allier avec LFI

en.title: LIVE, left-wing primary: Raphaël Glucksmann, elected in the first round, promises to "unite" the left to "beat the far-right", and reaffirms his refusal to ally with LFI
en.summary: The MEP was designated as the social-democratic left's presidential candidate with 66% of votes, significantly ahead of Socialist Party leader Olivier Faure at 14%, with other candidates receiving less than 10%.

stories.title: Primaire sociale-démocrate : Raphaël Glucksmann élu dès le premier tour avec 66 % des votes

en.title: Social-democratic primary: Raphaël Glucksmann elected in the first round with 66% of votes

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann designated in the first round as the social-democratic left's candidate
en.summary: The Place publique leader decisively outpaced Socialist Party chief Olivier Faure and extended outreach to other leftist forces excluding LFI.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Volodymyr Zelensky affirme que la Russie a frappé des installations énergétiques après l’annonce par Donald Trump d’un cessez-le-feu énergétique

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Volodymyr Zelensky claims Russia struck energy installations after Donald Trump announced energy ceasefire
en.summary: Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine agreed to stop attacks on each other's energy infrastructure, but Zelensky reported that Russia struck energy facilities following this announcement.

stories.title: Vainqueur de la primaire, Raphaël Glucksmann promet «une campagne punk» pour la présidentielle

en.title: Primary winner Raphaël Glucksmann promises "punk campaign" for presidential election
en.summary: Place publique candidate Raphaël Glucksmann won the socialist primary on October 11 and is preparing for a presidential campaign, having discussed his trajectory and strategic changes before the vote.

stories.title: Résultats de la primaire socialiste : Raphaël Glucksmann élu dès le premier tour et propulsé vers la présidentielle

en.title: Socialist primary results: Raphaël Glucksmann elected in first round and propelled toward presidential election
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann secured 66 percent of votes among 120,000 social-democrat voters on Sunday, substantially outperforming PS first secretary Olivier Faure who received only 14 percent.

en.title: 2027 presidential election: primary winner Raphaël Glucksmann becomes candidate of non-Mélenchon left
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann decisively won the primary with 66.17 percent of votes and must now unite defeated rivals including Olivier Faure and Ségolène Royal while facing competition from former president François Hollande.
